bibl.title: Searching for Ptolemy XII: inscriptions from Sinai.
bibl.seg: Hesham Hussein, Searching for Ptolemy XII: inscriptions from Sinai.
bibl.note: Gives a look at some ﬁnds from Tell Maessalem, near Port Said: well-preserved blocks [with hieroglyphs] of an as yet unidentiﬁed cult building of Ptolemy XII Auletes (c. 80-58 and 55-51 BC) for the ﬁrst time reveal historical traces of that king in the north-western region of the Sinai Peninsula.
